about: Team stats. Each car is rated 0-10 in every stat; 5 is the stock car. Each point away from 5 changes the listed CarParams fields linearly: value *= 1 + per_point * (points - 5); an effect written as {"deficit": k} instead scales how far a value is below 1 (a DRS cut): value = 1 - (1 - value) * (1 + k * (points - 5)). A team spends at most the budget over all stats (10 stats x 5 = 50: raising one stat means lowering another). A full 0-10 swing in a lap-time stat is worth a few tenths a lap.

categories.label: Top speed
categories.about: Less drag and longer gearing: faster on the straights and a higher speed limit, slower off the line.

categories.label: Engine power
categories.about: More engine torque: quicker out of corners (and a little faster at the top).

categories.label: Downforce
categories.about: More aero grip in fast corners, at a small cost in drag.

categories.label: Handling
categories.about: Mechanical grip and a more agile chassis: slow corners and traction.

categories.label: Tyre
categories.about: Kinder suspension and cooling: tyres wear more slowly and run cooler.

categories.label: Brakes
categories.about: More braking force and better disc cooling: later braking from high speed, less fade.

categories.label: Pit crew
categories.about: A quicker pit crew: a stop takes 3.6 s at 0, 2.8 s at 5 and 2.0 s at 10.

categories.label: KERS
categories.about: A stronger motor-generator and a bigger store: more power and more energy each lap.

categories.label: DRS
categories.about: A bigger drag cut when the flap is open, and a quicker flap: stronger on the straights behind another car.

categories.label: Gearbox
categories.about: Faster shifts: less time without drive at each gear change, and a little less transmission loss.
